name: St Peter and St Thomas More, Middleton & Alkrington
shortName: St Peter and St Thomas More

boundary.description: From the junction of Parkfield Drive and Manchester Old Road, E along Manchester Old Road, Middleton Way, Barton Road, Park Road to and E along River Irk, to the point opposite Whitby Street. Then by a beeline NE along, but excluding Gleenwood Drive to the point where Rochdale Canal meets Rochdale – Oldham District boundary. Then S by that boundary to Middleton Road, to and S along Rochdale Canal to junction 21 on M60 Motorway. Then W along the M60 Motorway and Rochdale – Manchester District boundary to the point where it meets Wince Brook. E by the Brook to the point opposite Parkfiled Drive and by a beeline to the Parkfield Drive.

internalBoundaries.name: Former boundary between St Peter and St Thomas More
internalBoundaries.description: From the point opposite to Parkfield Drive on Wince Brook to the pint opposite Greenson Drive on Wince Brook, by a bee-line to Hall Driver, Alkrington Hall Road North, Manchester New Road (A664), E along Mount Road, and along Round Thorn Road in a straight line to and S along Wince Brook to Rochdale – Oldham District boundary. Then by that boundary to M60 Motorway.
